Why is UPSC considered one of the toughest exams?

According to AIR 100 Sattwik Satyakam Devta, the biggest challenge isn't necessarily the syllabus or the study material. It is the level of competition.

Thousands of strong candidates prepare for a limited number of positions, making the exam highly competitive.

In this short clip, Sattwik explains what really makes UPSC so difficult and why understanding the competition is important for every aspirant.
